purpose: Mask-stage preservation of encoded epidermis, necrosis, vessels, components, and interfaces; melanoma growth pattern remains a rendering requirement.

constraints.mask_statement: Epidermis, necrosis, vessel, and every other unrequested semantic label remain pixel-identical in a generic burden edit.
required_inputs: semantic mask with the declared PUMA/profile mapping
generation_handoff: Preserve epidermal continuity, necrotic appearance, and vessel morphology visually.
known_limitations: A coarse profile may not label regression, junctional melanoma, ulceration, or small vessels.

constraints.mask_statement: If junctional component, ulcerated surface, regression bed, or small vessels are available as auxiliary regions, exclude them; if they are visible only on digest-bound native/auxiliary structure authority, mask edit cannot assert their preservation and must abstain when the band overlaps them ambiguously.
generation_handoff: Cohesive versus discohesive growth, ulceration, and regression morphology must be rendered and audited after mask selection.
known_limitations: Mask gaps cannot diagnose ulceration and stromal labels cannot diagnose regression.

constraints.mask_statement: Every changed component must touch one selected directed interface, stay inside its allowed band, and avoid rectangle-like or short/deep geometry.
generation_handoff: Use a primary/metastatic- and growth-pattern-matched H&E reference for rendering.
known_limitations: Geometric continuity cannot distinguish cohesive nests from dispersed melanoma cells.

constraints.mask_statement: Reject tumor islands, bridges between separate foci, source splits, target merges, and new/filled holes.
known_limitations: Dedicated satellite-creation or topology-changing tasks are outside v1.
